content: ANTI-AI-SLOP UNIVERSAL RULES: 1. NEVER use placeholders (lorem ipsum, TODO). 2. Every UI MUST have Loading, Empty, Error, Success states. 3. Every interactive element MUST have hover, focus-visible, active states. 4. Every async function MUST have try/catch. 5. NEVER use generic AI colors (purple-pink gradients). 6. NEVER use generic AI copy (seamless, leverage, empower, unlock, robust, actionable, data-driven, solutions, elevate, delve). 7. Every fetch MUST handle loading, 4xx, 5xx, timeout, empty. 8. Forms MUST have client + server validation. 9. Lists MUST have empty states. 10. Every page needs ONE clear CTA.
